title: Start tomato sauce
description: Soften onion and garlic, add tomatoes, then simmer gently.

title: Season and reduce sauce
description: Taste for salt and acidity. Reduce until the sauce coats a spoon.

title: Boil salted water
description: Use a large pot and salt the water once it comes to a boil.

title: Cook pasta
description: Cook until just shy of al dente and reserve a cup of pasta water.

title: Finish pasta in sauce
description: Toss pasta with sauce, pasta water, and cheese until glossy.

title: Toast garlic bread
description: Spread garlic butter on bread and toast until browned.

title: Dress salad
description: Toss greens and vegetables with dressing right before serving.
